decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management offer, the firm has invested in it and promotes it publicly, and its continued presence on the website gives no sign of failure, so management persists with it.

The cleaning centrifuge fits the announced direction of sustainable, efficient coolant filtration and builds on established capabilities, so the sunk development costs and strategic fit justify keeping it even if early sales are modest.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the firm's conveying portfolio and are still shown on the website, so dropping them would contradict its visible commitment to metalworking customers.

Hinged belt conveyors are central to the chip conveying range, and with the magnetic variant already pruned, management will defend the remaining core conveyors and treat any weak results as temporary.
